rules.note: Type Group is a visual grouping pattern, not a subtype slicer.
Visual titles such as Fleet Size are labels; evaluate bound identifier or validated measure only.

vessel_register_route.description: Dump of every IMO and its attributes (type, sub type, manager/DOC, owner, handover, takeover, deadweight). Plain or generic vessel/IMO questions go here.
vessel_register_route.rule: Vessel, IMO, sub type, vessel type, manager/DOC or count-of-vessels question with no module term -> this report. A module term (for example injury, incident) -> that module's report instead.

vessel_context.note: Most semantic models hold the vessel register in one of these tables. Use whichever table the model actually has; never assume a name the model does not contain.
vessel_context.doc_meaning: DOC = Document of Compliance holder. MANAGER_GROUP stores it as the full registered company name or as an acronym (for example SOMI, SMPL). Resolve a user's company term by matching it against the DISTINCT values of MANAGER_GROUP in the model, case-insensitively, including acronym and full-name forms, and filter on the exact stored value.
vessel_context.count_rule: Vessel count = DISTINCT IMO in the vessel register table after the requested filters. Prefer a measure already in the model or on the report that returns this value over writing new DAX.
